purpose: Phase 7 trace, entity, scenario-family, domain and physical-source generalization checks

application_proxy_holdout.rule: development and evaluation families are disjoint
application_proxy_holdout.claim_limit: scenario-family proxy; not a real deployed application-id holdout

domain_holdout.selection_rule: two domains sampled without replacement from the sorted eight-domain list before the run
domain_holdout.training_rule: exclude held-out domains from PPO semantic training items
domain_holdout.claim_limit: policy-domain generalization conditional on reference semantics; frozen extractors were not retrained leave-domain-out

physical_source_ablations.policy: load the same v2_nep checkpoints; change one evaluation source layer at a time
physical_source_ablations.replacement_fit_rule: BUPT replacements use train windows only; EUA fixed topology uses a seeded 80% fit partition
physical_source_ablations.claim_limit: evaluation-distribution counterfactual, not policy retraining sensitivity
